src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2011 court-adopted congressional plan, Guy v. Miller (four districts)

Nevada Legislature, 2011 Reapportionment & Redistricting: First Judicial District Court (Judge James T. Russell) order of Oct 27, 2011 and final addendum of Dec 8, 2011 adopting the Special Masters' Senate, Assembly and congressional districts

Drawn by court-appointed Special Masters because the Governor vetoed the Legislature's plan; order Oct 27, 2011, final addendum Dec 8, 2011; Nevada gained its fourth seat. Used 2012 through 2020. Census cb_2020 files hold the plans the Bureau collected for the 2018 election (116th Congress, 2018 legislative districts, per its user note); this state did not change them before the 2020 election.
